status: Evaluated transaction records and private projection recovery; no production value index or serving adoption
behavior: Canonical records bind database name and generation, resulting revision, original snapshot revision, request identity/fingerprint, retention floor and ordered final mutations
Empty values and deletions are distinct; application code and historical reads are not rerun
Per-database revisions must be contiguous; retained request reuse and wrong database state fail recovery
Receipt retention follows each immutable recorded floor, which cannot regress; no fixed 128-receipt policy in the replacement component
Retained matching receipts resolve before snapshot age; absence below the floor is expired, never proof of failure
An unread selected-history cursor and unpublished target are consumed; errors or cancellation drop the private target
Success returns only after complete selected history and grants no current ownership or serving permission
